description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ClientMustBePendingToBeDeletedException' which extends an abstract platform domain rule exception. It is used to indicate an error condition when attempting to delete a client that is not in the 'Pending' state.

classes.name: ClientMustBePendingToBeDeletedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a client cannot be deleted unless it is in the 'Pending' state. It extends the abstract exception class to be used within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: ClientMustBePendingToBeDeletedException
methods.description: Constructor that takes a client ID and initializes the exception with a specific error message indicating the deletion constraint.

calls: super("error.msg.clients.cannot.be.deleted", "Client with identifier " + id + " cannot be deleted as it is not in Pending state.", id)
